description: Unique service-request identifier. Keep as text for duplicate checks and traceability; exclude from predictors.
Request creation date and time. Parse as a datetime; derive calendar features rather than use the raw timestamp.
Date and time the responding agency recorded closure. Used to calculate the outcome; exclude from predictors.
Responding agency acronym. DOT means Department of Transportation; constant after filtering.
Full responding agency name; Department of Transportation in every row.
Broad problem category. Street Condition in every row; descriptor provides the varying problem detail.
Specific street-condition problem, with 21 observed categories defined below. These labels are not an ordered severity scale.
Geovalidated incident ZIP code. Preserve as text; numerical magnitude has no predictive interpretation. Codes are listed in the category inventory.
First intersecting street from the geovalidated incident location. High-cardinality location text.
Second intersecting street from the geovalidated incident location. High-cardinality location text.
Type of incident-location information, such as an address, intersection, or street segment. Six observed labels are defined below.
City or locality name returned by geovalidation. Values are not necessarily borough names; partly redundant with other geography.
City facility type associated with a request, if available. Entirely blank in this snapshot.
Request status at collection, not necessarily status at submission. Closed, Pending, and Open are defined below. Used for labeling only.
Last action described by the responding agency, sometimes including next steps. Exclude because it can reveal post-submission handling.
Date and time the responding agency last updated the request. Post-submission information; exclude from predictors.
Geovalidated community-board label, typically a board number plus borough. Exceptional labels are retained as source values and need validation.
City Council district containing the request. Values 1 through 51 identify districts, not a ranking; saved CSV uses decimal-looking codes.
NYPD precinct containing the request. Precinct numbers identify jurisdictions, not a ranking; Unspecified means not identified.
Incident borough, submitted and confirmed by geovalidation. Five NYC boroughs plus Unspecified.

Geovalidated horizontal coordinate in the source state-plane system. The source field description does not specify units or CRS; verify before interpreting distances. Redundant with latitude/longitude.
Geovalidated vertical coordinate in the source state-plane system. The source field description does not specify units or CRS; verify before interpreting distances. Redundant with latitude/longitude.
How the request was submitted: PHONE, ONLINE, OTHER, or UNKNOWN in this snapshot.
Name of a Parks Department facility, if applicable. Every saved value is the placeholder Unspecified.
Source park-related borough field. In this snapshot its values match borough row for row, so retain only borough for initial modeling.
Incident latitude in decimal degrees. Missing values must be handled within the training pipeline.
Incident longitude in decimal degrees. Missing values must be handled within the training pipeline.
Serialized geographic point containing longitude then latitude. Duplicates the separate coordinate fields; do not treat as a third independent location measurement.
Incident-address text supplied for the location. High-cardinality location field; retain for audit rather than the initial predictor matrix.
Street name of the incident address supplied by the submitter. High-cardinality location text.
First cross street associated with the geovalidated incident location. High-cardinality location text.
Second cross street associated with the geovalidated incident location. High-cardinality location text.
Third level of problem detail. Only Other appears, in 20 rows; the remaining 70,302 rows are blank. Exclude initially because it is nearly empty.
Type of location associated with the request, with six observed labels defined below. Frequently missing; optional candidate requiring missing-value handling.
Landmark name associated with the incident location when available. High-cardinality location text.
Borough-Block-Lot parcel identifier from geovalidation. Preserve as an identifier, not a continuous measurement; decimal suffixes are serialization artifacts.
Derived recorded duration in hours: (closed_date - created_date).total_seconds() / 3600. Missing when closure is unavailable; excludes negative durations. Never include in predictors.

1 means recorded administrative closure within 48 hours inclusive. 0 means closure after 48 hours, or missing closure with Pending/Open status at collection. See target rules and follow-up assumption below.
